The RTX 5080 is priced at $999 and includes all new GeForce RTX 50 features with good gaming performance, but the gen-over-gen performance increase is smaller than expected, though NVIDIA didn't raise pricing.

The 980 was $549 in 2014 (~$730 today); the 5080 at $999 is only 1.3x that price, yet its geometric mean performance score is 8.5x higher — a good price-to-performance improvement compared to many other components.
The 4080 Super seems to have a better performance-per-watt ratio and lower temps than the 5080 and 5090, even though it's behind them in raw performance in many benchmarks.
